description: Engaging Stakeholders in Planning for Sea Level Rise is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management; San Francisco Bay Conservation and Development Commission. Sea level rise is changing the shoreline of San Francisco Bay, endangering homes, habitats, and vital infrastructure. Stakeholders from a diverse array of sectors around the Bay are participating in preparations through a regional partnership. Coverage: the United States (2014). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
